title: HIPAA & HITRUST Endpoint Compliance & Vulnerability Remediation (Intune + Defender)
author_notes: Derived from a Senior Endpoint Engineer (healthcare/Epic) requirement: ensure compliance (HIPAA, HITRUST) and remediate vulnerabilities.

Scope: map HIPAA Security Rule + HITRUST CSF control expectations to enforceable Intune compliance/config baselines + Conditional Access gating + Defender for Endpoint vulnerability remediation, with audit-ready evidence/reporting. Technical enforcement + evidence, NOT legal certification. White-label.
pricing: T4 (project) — multi-control mapping + compliance + CA + Defender remediation + evidence.
